name: PT TIMAH Tbk
summary: PT TIMAH Tbk, an Indonesian entity, primarily focuses on the extraction and refinement of tin. Its diverse operations are structured across several divisions, including tin mining, industrial endeavors, construction, coal mining, and a range of other business activities. The company provides various tin-based products, such as Banka, Mentok, Banka low lead, and Kundur tin, in addition to tin solder and chemical formulations. Furthermore, its product offerings extend beyond tin to include materials like coal, nickel, and quartz sand. PT TIMAH Tbk also delivers a broad array of services, encompassing workshop operations, construction projects, shipping dockyard management, real estate development, healthcare, transportation logistics, engineering and vessel maintenance, and marketing agency functions. Its scope also includes involvement in agriculture and trading. The firm's products reach both domestic and international markets via export. Founded in 1976, the company maintains its headquarters in Bangka, Indonesia. It operates as a subsidiary of PT Indonesia Asahan Aluminium (Persero).
